summary.text: Lori Korzen is a Republican state representative from Coos District 7 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, where she has served since December 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Lori Korzen assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 4, 2024, succeeding Democrat Eamon Kelley.
She advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Coos 7, where Corinne Cascadden is also a candidate.
